title: 第21章 书中的世界第22章 买药争执
lines: 这些书的内容，十分丰富，有奇异地形，也有关于不同城市的风俗画卷。
李骏飞快地翻阅着，眼神在文字和图画间跳跃，虽然翻书的速度惊人，但每个字、每个图都像刻在脑海中一般。
这几年，在潘庄河身边历练，李骏的脑瓜越来越好使，也许是长大了的缘故，在学习药材知识时，这种能力也表现得尤为突出。
但更关键的是，体内的松果每晚吸收光点对他的滋养，这些他惘然不知。
黄子洞曾见识过李骏这过目不忘的本领，还笑着羡慕他天生有个好脑袋，如果李骏小时候在书荷有这么开窍，估计也不会被赶出家门了。
看着书中的内容，李骏的神情逐渐凝重起来。
他从小生活在科峰城，从未真正接触过外面的世界，而眼前的这本书却像一扇通往浩瀚未知的大门，展现出了一幅极为广阔且危险的图景。
书中的内容让他意识到，自己对这个世界的理解不过是沧海一粟。
夏国，只是自己所在疆域的一部分。
除此之外，还有宁国，法吉国，宋庆国等国家。
另外还有一些地域是人烟罕至的，都是凶兽盘踞。
李骏所在的夏国，有许多城市，但大多数都是灵气匮乏的小城。
那些灵气大城，都在宁国的掌控之下，或者是一些修仙世家的掌控之下。
这些修仙世家和这些国家，繁荣表象，暗藏风云。
各方势力，相互斗争，为了资源不惜大动干戈，战乱频发。
凡人们常常为了避祸，宁愿迁徙到偏远小城，而不敢靠近那些充满争斗，资源丰富，灵气充裕的大城。
书中还提到，每年都有无数的年轻人，带着壮志和梦想，从各个小城前往大城，希望在那里得到机缘，拜入仙门。
这些年轻人中，有些是天生拥有仙根，得以感应天地灵气的幸运儿，他们可以成为修行者，追寻长生之道；而更多的则是普通的凡人，不甘一生平庸，渴望通过自身努力在大城中谋得一席之地。
他们中有些人选择成为商队的一员，带着各类稀奇的异域物资行走于各地，甚至穿越尼木内海，五通山，法吉沙漠等地，将珍贵药材与宝物带到各处，赚取丰厚的利润......
读到此处，李骏心中震撼，这个世界远比他想象中的更加波澜壮阔。
同时，他也燃起了一个念头——他想要去看看这个世界，想要去探索书中提到的那些仙门。
“我一定要去大城看看！”
李骏心中暗暗发誓，眼中闪烁着坚定的光芒。
李骏又拿出另外一本仙道简录看了起来，里面还真提及了修仙的仙人，那些人统称为修士。
修仙者的修行之路漫长而艰难，境界从最初的炼气，筑基、金丹，再到元婴、化神，直至炼虚、合体，大成等巅峰，还有传说中的成仙。
这条道路，每前进一步，都是修行者的生死考验。
而其中每一个境界的划分，都意味着修士对于天地规则的理解更加深入，同时也意味着力量的飞跃。
看到这里，李骏内心火热，但是他在科峰城内这么久，都没见到过修仙者，虽然他常年呆在药膳坊，足不出户。
前几年，曾有一位坐着飞豹的青年现身于城头，引起了全城的轰动。
那位青年仅仅在城中逗留了两天，便飞身离去，却让科峰城的各大势力争相接触，仿佛见到了一位高不可攀的存在。
关于科峰城，他生活了三年，但书中的内容却让他对科峰城有了全新的认识。
科峰城只是夏国的一个小城，主要以贩药为生，城周围依山傍水，灵气并不充足，但是这里灵药却经常产出，让人惊奇。
修士在这里寥寥无几，科峰城里基本都是凡人，但因为药仙门的缘故，有不少灵器，书籍流入科峰城。
修仙界对于凡人的国度基本不会干涉，但是凡人要想进入修仙界的仙城，就比较难，很多仙城不对凡人开放。
书中提到的凤峦山，那座山上栖息着开了灵智的妖兽，极为凶残和狡猾。
每二十年，妖兽们便会发动一次兽潮，席卷整个科峰城，冲击一切抵挡在它们面前的生灵。
content_en:
The content of these books is very rich, including strange terrains and customs pictures of different cities.
Li Jun flipped through the pages quickly, his eyes jumping between the words and pictures. Although he flipped through the book at an alarming speed, every word and picture seemed to be engraved in his mind.
In the past few years, Li Jun's brain has become better and better after practicing around Pan Zhuanghe. Perhaps because he has grown up, this ability has also become particularly prominent when learning about medicinal materials.
But more importantly, the pine cones in his body absorbed the nourishment from the light spots every night, which he was unaware of.
Huang Zidong had seen Li Jun's photographic memory before, and smiled and envied him for being born with a good mind. If Li Jun had been so enlightened in Shuhe when he was a child, he probably wouldn't have been kicked out of the house.
Looking at the contents of the book, Li Jun's expression gradually became serious.
He has lived in Kefeng City since he was a child and has never really been exposed to the outside world. However, the book in front of him is like a door to the vast unknown, showing an extremely broad and dangerous picture.
The content in the book made him realize that his understanding of the world was just a drop in the ocean.
The Xia Kingdom is only a part of its own territory.
In addition, there are Ningguo, Fajiguo, Song Qingguo and other countries.
In addition, there are some areas that are sparsely populated and inhabited by ferocious beasts.
There are many cities in the Xia Kingdom where Li Jun is located, but most of them are small towns lacking in spiritual energy.
Those spiritual cities are all under the control of Ning Guo, or under the control of some immortal cultivating families.
These immortal cultivating families and these countries appear to be prosperous, but they are hiding in trouble.
Forces from all sides are fighting against each other, and they are willing to go to war for resources, causing frequent wars.
Mortal people often prefer to move to remote small towns to avoid disasters, rather than approaching big cities that are full of fights, rich in resources, and full of spiritual energy.
The book also mentions that every year, countless young people, with their ambitions and dreams, travel from small towns to big cities, hoping to get a chance there and worship the immortals.
Some of these young people are lucky ones who are born with immortal roots and can sense the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. They can become practitioners and pursue the path to immortality; while more are ordinary mortals who are unwilling to live a mediocre life and are eager to find a place in the big city through their own efforts.
Some of them choose to become members of caravans, traveling around with all kinds of rare and exotic materials, and even travel through the Nimu Inland Sea, Wutong Mountain, Faj Desert and other places, bringing precious medicinal materials and treasures everywhere, earning huge profits...
After reading this, Li Jun was shocked. The world was far more magnificent than he imagined.
At the same time, he also had an idea - he wanted to see the world and explore the fairy gates mentioned in the book.
"I must go to the big city to see it!"
Li Jun secretly swore in his heart, with a firm light shining in his eyes.
Li Jun took out another book of immortality and read it. It actually mentioned immortals who cultivated immortality. Those people were collectively called monks.
The path of cultivation for immortal cultivators is long and arduous, ranging from the initial Qi refining, foundation building, golden elixir, to Nascent Soul, Soul Transformation, to the pinnacles of Void Refining, Fusion, Dacheng, and even the legendary immortality.
On this path, every step forward is a life and death test for the practitioner.
The division of each realm means that the monks have a deeper understanding of the rules of heaven and earth, and it also means a leap in power.
Seeing this, Li Jun felt hot in his heart, but he had never seen an immortal cultivator in Kefeng City for so long, even though he stayed at the Medicinal Food Shop all year round and never left home.
A few years ago, a young man sitting on a flying leopard appeared at the top of the city, causing a sensation throughout the city.
The young man only stayed in the city for two days and then flew away. However, the major forces in Kefeng City rushed to contact him, as if he had seen an unattainable being.
He has lived in Kefeng City for three years, but the content in the book gave him a new understanding of Kefeng City.
Kefeng City is just a small town in the Xia Kingdom. It mainly makes a living by selling medicine. The city is surrounded by mountains and rivers, and there is not enough spiritual energy. However, elixirs are often produced here, which is surprising.
There are very few monks here, and Kefeng City is basically filled with mortals. However, because of the Yaoxian Sect, many spiritual weapons and books have flowed into Kefeng City.
The world of immortality will basically not interfere with the kingdom of mortals, but it is more difficult for mortals to enter the fairy cities in the world of immortality. Many fairy cities are not open to mortals.
The Fengluan Mountain mentioned in the book is inhabited by monsters with enlightened intelligence, which are extremely ferocious and cunning.
Every twenty years, the monsters will launch a beast tide that sweeps through the entire Kefeng City, attacking all creatures that stand in front of them.
